The '''Shili system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Ehosiq sector/Legends|Ehosiq sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shili/Legends|Shili]].
